episodes.title: Paisaje atlántico
episodes.summary: Elmer, an assassin posing as a gardener, is tasked with killing Violeta, a seemingly troubled young woman. The police catch wind of a suspected murder.

episodes.title: Germinación de las semillas
episodes.summary: As Violeta and Elmer grow closer, he lands a new victim. News about his health and newfound feelings lead him to consider defying his mother's orders.

episodes.title: Sustrato orgánico
episodes.summary: China debates finishing Elmer's job for him. The search for a missing person sparks questions about Violeta's past and her latest partner.

episodes.title: Control de plagas
episodes.summary: Torres and Carrera visit a professor who may be able to help them. Mother and son grow distant as Elmer tries to convince Violeta to spend time together.

episodes.title: Isla de descomposición
episodes.summary: Elmer considers resuming his assignment after an argument with Violeta. Torres and Carrera scope out a possible location of their prime suspect.

episodes.title: Calendario de podas
episodes.summary: Violeta and Elmer both face the reality of their situation. China offers her son a way out — but can he trust her to hide the evidence from the police?
